file-sizes-rule.desc: Verifies that no source file has more than a specified maximum number of lines.
file-sizes-rule.rationale: To encourage smaller, more focused files.
file-sizes-rule.config: - max: max number of lines (default 99) - ignore: list of exempt files or folders (root-relative, e.g. `src/generated`); a folder exempts every file at or below it
